answer: Require each agent account to lock 100 coins for 30 days. Pay a fixed reward pool pro rata to locked stake and sum votes by stake, with no per-account bonus. Whether its keys are labeled relic, ridge, tide, wharf, willow or meadow, splitting the same capital cannot increase its total reward share or voting weight. Running 1,000 eligible accounts concurrently requires locking 100,000 coins. The cost is lost liquidity or borrowing expense, not burned funds; wealthy attackers remain possible.
